site.title: ArchXS: exactly as much architecture as needed
site.description: A boutique advisory and engineering practice built on architecture on demand: architectural effort proportional to risk, the rest of the effort in a working system. Enterprise architecture, processes, security, applied AI, physical AI, blockchain and Web3, software delivery.

method.title: Architecture on demand: the method
method.description: The ArchXS method: architectural effort proportional to risk, the last responsible moment, executable architecture in CI, a decision log as the minimal artifact. With its lineage: Fairbanks, fitness functions, Nygard's ADRs.

engage.title: Working together
engage.description: Shapes of engagement with ArchXS: a diagnostic, architecture on demand (effort sized to one decision), architecture as a service (standing oversight without a staff architect), ongoing advisory, delivery.
